en_text: Critical Error: Camera cannot be reached
Camera is blocked or it is too dark. Obstacle warnings may be missing.
fil_text: Natatakpan ang camera o masyadong madilim. Maaaring may mga harang na hindi mababanggit.

en_text: Camera is facing very bright light. Obstacle warnings may be missing.
fil_text: Nakaharap ang camera sa napakaliwanag na ilaw. Maaaring may mga harang na hindi mababanggit.

en_text: Controller board cannot be reached. Using the current settings.
fil_text: Hindi makonekta ang controller. Gagamitin ang kasalukuyang settings.
